en.summary: Fixes single-warp operand-collector arbitration. When scalar/X and vector/V issue streams compete in a num_warp=1 build, fixed V-first priority can starve one stream and stop forward progress.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says a num_warp=1 bug is fixed.
The patch changes operandCollector arbitration in pipeline DUT logic, not only tests.
The new logic adds stateful alternating priority specifically to avoid blocking one instruction stream.
evidence: operandCollector.scala adds a priorityXorV register and a dedicated num_warp == 1 arbitration branch.
The old path always selected V first from outReady1 and then X from the remaining ready set.
The fix alternates which stream gets the first collector slot when num_warp == 1.
Makefile/tests only adjust timeout around the same stall-oriented bug.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A shared collector or issue-allocation stage must not use permanent fixed priority between two simultaneously valid instruction classes when only one execution context exists. In a single-context design, one class can keep losing the first free slot forever, turning an arbitration preference into starvation and eventual pipeline hang.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Two instruction streams of different classes become valid together while only one or two collector entries are free in a single-warp or single-context configuration.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Replace alternating or round-robin first-choice arbitration with a fixed preference for one stream.
portability_notes: Map this to any shared allocator that accepts two decoded streams into a common pool.
The exact names of the two streams do not matter; the bug is unfair first-slot selection under single-context pressure.
If the target DUT already uses round-robin or toggle-based fairness, remove only that fairness state and keep the rest of the datapath unchanged.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that chooses which of two ready input streams receives the first free collector or issue slot.
In the single-context configuration, remove the fairness toggle or round-robin state update.
Force one stream to always claim the first ready slot and let the other stream consume only a leftover slot.
Leave multi-context arbitration unchanged so the reinjected bug stays close to the original scope.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix added a num_warp == 1 branch with a toggling priorityXorV register so V and X streams alternate first priority instead of always granting V first.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In instDemux, remove the alternating num_warp == 1 branch and revert to the original V-first PriorityEncoderOH/PriorityEncoder selection sequence.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: One instruction class can be starved in single-warp mode, leading to severe stalls or a hang even though collector entries continue to free and refill.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional RTL change is the new alternating arbitration path in operandCollector.scala.
The added comment explicitly says the change ensures instructions are not blocked when num_warp = 1.
The reverted behavior is a simple fixed-priority policy, so the fault can be reinjected cleanly.
notes: The portable bug is starvation from unfair arbitration, not a source-specific signal naming issue.
The Makefile/test timeout changes are not part of the injected fault.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了单 warp 配置下 operand collector 的仲裁问题。当 scalar/X 与 vector/V 两类发射流在 num_warp=1 构建中同时竞争时，固定的 V 优先级会让其中一类长期饥饿并停止前进。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是 num_warp=1 的缺陷。
补丁修改的是流水线 DUT 里的 operandCollector 仲裁逻辑，而不是仅改测试。
新逻辑专门加入了交替优先级状态，用来避免某一类指令流被阻塞。
evidence: operandCollector.scala 新增了 priorityXorV 寄存器，以及 num_warp == 1 的专用仲裁分支。
旧逻辑总是先从 outReady1 中选择 V，再从剩余 ready 集合中选择 X。
修复后在 num_warp == 1 时会交替决定哪一类流先拿到 collector 槽位。
Makefile/测试的改动只是围绕同一个停顿类问题调整超时。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 共享 collector 或发射分配级在只有一个执行上下文时，不能对两个同时有效的指令类别永久使用固定优先级。在单上下文设计里，一类请求可能永远抢不到第一个空槽，从普通优先级退化为长期饥饿，最终导致流水线挂起。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 单上下文 issue/collector 公平性
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 在单 warp 或单上下文配置下，两类不同指令流同时有效，而空闲 collector 槽位只有一个或两个。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把交替或轮转的首选仲裁改回对其中一类流的固定优先。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何把两路已解码指令流送入共享资源池的分配器。
两类流的具体名字不重要，核心缺陷是在单上下文压力下首槽位分配不公平。
如果目标 DUT 已有轮转或 toggle 公平机制，只删除这部分公平状态，其他数据通路保持不变。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到从两路 ready 输入中选择谁获得第一个空闲 collector 或发射槽位的逻辑。
在单上下文配置下移除公平 toggle 或 round-robin 状态更新。
强制其中一路永远先拿第一个 ready 槽位，另一路只能吃剩余槽位。
多上下文路径保持不变，使回注故障尽量贴近原始缺陷范围。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: num_warp == 1 时 instDemux 的 collector 槽位仲裁
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复为 num_warp == 1 增加了带 priorityXorV 翻转寄存器的分支，让 V 与 X 流轮流获得首优先级，而不再固定先给 V。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 instDemux 中删除交替仲裁的 num_warp == 1 分支，恢复为原来的 V-first PriorityEncoderOH/PriorityEncoder 选择序列。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在单 warp 模式下，一类指令流会长期饥饿，导致严重停顿甚至挂起，尽管 collector 槽位仍在释放和重新分配。
evidence_for_injection: 唯一的功能性 RTL 变更就是 operandCollector.scala 中新增的交替仲裁路径。
补丁内注释明确写出此修改是为避免 num_warp = 1 时指令被阻塞。
要回注的旧行为就是简单固定优先级，因此可干净地逆向注入。
notes: 可移植的缺陷本质是不公平仲裁导致饥饿，而不是源仓库中的某个具体信号名。
Makefile/测试超时调整不属于故障注入内容。
